dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D reduction in planar width from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-gray median pixel intensity, indicating a sub-adult or near-mature tonal phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Concentrated cluster of dark-pixel clusters (residual grey patches) located on the central dorsal axis, posterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition between the pigmented mottled regions and the primary light-gray dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Cluster of small, high-contrast dark-pigmented spots on the central dorsal plane.
